scope: recorded readiness/potential contracts, unassessed states, aggregate 9-box mapping, denominator reconciliation, Unknown departments, legacy proxy retirement and API serialization
confirmed_behavior: Missing ratings remain Unassessed and do not become readiness scores.
Bench, gap and 9-box summaries use actual engine keys and reconcile aggregate denominators.
Unknown departments retain unassessed active people; legacy rating/tenure high-potential proxies are not the current contract.
interpretation_boundary: Succession results reflect recorded assessments and aggregate coverage, not validated potential, future performance or authority to rank employees for employment action.
remaining_scientific_limits: Requires independent assessment reliability, role-specific successor coverage and future-performance validation.
Legacy individual heuristic helpers must remain retired or explicitly bounded.
release_gate: Safe for recorded aggregate assessment reporting; individual selection and predictive readiness claims remain blocked.
